The '''Order of Zildrog''' was a militant organization that emerged on [[Zakuul]] following the [[War against Zakuul|fall]] of the [[Eternal Empire]]. Driven to avenge his people's defeat, [[Vinn Atrius]] brought together various individuals and factions with different agendas who were united in their hatred of the Alliance and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] who commanded it. Learning about [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from [[Iokath]], Atrius was informed by [[GEMINI 16]], a rogue [[GEMINI]] unit who sought the destruction of the [[Eternal Fleet]], of its workings and whereabouts, giving the Order the means to bring the Alliance down.

One of the Alliance's original founders [[Theron Shan]] learned about the Order and decided to work against it from the inside. Shan led the Commander into a trap on Iokath and later revealed himself as a traitor during the [[Crisis on Umbara|mission]] to [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Faking his defection to the Order, Shan stalled them with false data while he chased Zildrog's location by infiltrating the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] to obtain the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] leading to it. After the Order found Zildrog on [[Nathema]], Theron send an encrypted message to the Alliance, convincing them to [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|attend]] a rendezvous where he revealed his true allegiance and motives.

Together with [[Lana Beniko]] and the Commander, Theron tried to stop the Order from awakening Zildrog, but they were too late. Trapped in a [[force field]], they could do nothing but watch as GEMINI 16 activated Zildrog and revealed his secondary form to be none other than the ''[[Gravestone]]''. The Alliance's key asset was parked on [[Odessen]], from where Zildrog proceeded to remotely use it to systematically destroy the entirety of the [[Eternal Fleet]], which sat without orders in Odessen's orbit. After Zildrog prepared to target Odessen itself, the Alliance leadership used an opening to engage and destroy GEMINI 16, defeat Vinn Atrius and finally destroy Zildrog itself. Although the Order failed to achieve its primary goal, it nevertheless dealt a serious blow to the Alliance, depriving them of their most valuable military assets and causing many of its members to leave in the aftermath.

==History==
===Origins===
[[File:Vaylin_the_Last_Empress.jpg|thumb|left|250px|After the death of Empress Vaylin, her Horizon Guard Vinn Atrius sought revenge.]]
Around [[3630 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> the [[war against Zakuul]] of [[Zakuul]] ended with the [[Eternal Alliance]] toppling the [[Eternal Empire]] and acquiring some of its military assets, most importantly the [[Eternal Throne]] that controlled the [[Eternal Fleet]].<ref name="KOTET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> In the wake of the conquest [[Vinn Atrius]], a former member of Empress [[Vaylin]]'s [[Horizon Guard]], witnessed the plight of his people and the heavy toll of the war, coming to resent the Alliance and its [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], who brought an end to Zakuul's centuries of prosperity under [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Valkorion]]. Atrius became determined to take down the Alliance to avenge his people and began searching the [[GEMINI]] network for the means to do so. While browsing the data the Eternal Empire [[Escape from Iokath|obtained]] on [[Iokath]], he came upon the mentions of [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[dragon]] [[Deity/Legends|god]] from old Zakuulan legends. The data indicated that Zildrog was in fact an Iokath [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] with enough power to destroy entire civilizations and Atrius began to search for a way to find, awaken and control Zildrog.<ref name="Nathema" /> 

[[File:Vinn_Atrius_and_GEMINI_16.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vinn Atrius with GEMINI 16]]
Atrius formed the Order of Zildrog from other Zakuulan hardliners like himself, including rogue Horizon Guards, [[Knights of Zakuul|Knights]] and [[Scions of Zakuul]], [[Eternal Empire military]] soldiers, reprogrammed [[skytrooper]]s and cultists from the fringe [[Heralds of Zildrog]]. United by their hate of [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] for destroying their civilization, the secretive Order launched a [[Order of Zildrog campaign|campaign]] to bring the end of the Outlander and their Alliance.<ref name="Codex" /> They set up base of operations on an [[abandoned listening post]], where Atrius was approached by [[GEMINI 16]], who promised to share information on Zildrog in exchange for the destruction of the [[Eternal Fleet]]. GEMINI 16 acquired access to the security of the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], allowing the Order to observe and record Alliance's every step for months.<ref name="Nathema" />

===Crisis on Umbara===
[[File:Theron_Shan_leaves_Umbara.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Theron Shan leaves Umbara with the adegan crystals.]]
[[Theron Shan]], one of the Alliance's original founders, contacted Atrius expressing desire join the Order and bring the Alliance down. Atrius refused to listen to him, which led Shan to arrange a trap for the Commander on Iokath to prove his dedication. He then contacted Atrius again, insisting that his contributions were vital to the Order's success. Atrius distrusted Shan and pointed out that the events on Iokath gained the Alliance a powerful ally, whose support was now denied to the Order. Shan asked for a way to prove himself, and Atrius asked him to secure a shipment of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|adegan crystals]] from [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]].<ref name="Nathema" /> Theron [[Crisis on Umbara|traveled there]] along with the Commander and [[Lana Beniko]] and revealed his betrayal, trapping on a [[Train/Legends|train]] that was about to collide with a mountain. The Commander and Lana survived the crash, but Theron managed to secure a large part of the adegan crystals shipment, escaping with it on his shuttle.<ref name="Crisis">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Crisis on Umbara}}</ref>

===The search for Zildrog===
[[File:Valss_Stays_Behind.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Valss stays behind to allow Theron Shan to escape.]]
Impressed with his dedication to their cause, Atrius and the others reached a decision to welcome Theron Shan into the Order.<ref name="Crisis" /> Using his unique infiltration skills as a former [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[operative]], they tasked him with finding a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] with coordinates to Zildrog's location,<ref name="Chasing Copero">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171116|text="Chasing Copero"|int=Chasing Copero}}</ref> although GEMINI 16 warned Atrius not to trust Shan.<ref name="Nathema" /> Theron located a lead on the device stolen by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] agents from the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]],<ref name="Chasing Copero" /> and convinced ruling [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] of [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] to provide him refuge in exchange for Alliance secrets. Zenta's brother [[Valss]] was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and received a vision of Shan's victory, which led him and several of Zenta's best fighters to join the Order. Theron sliced into Zenta's personal [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to reveal the map's location in the [[Ancient ruins (Copero)|ancient ruins]] and abandoned the Syndic. He and Valss extracted Zildrog's coordinates and destroyed the holomap, but when they were about to depart the Commander and [[Raina Temple]] arrived to stop them. Valss stayed behind to buy the others time and was killed, while Theron escaped on shuttle and transmitted the coordinates to Atrius.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>

===Endgame on Nathema===
[[File:Zildrog_discovered.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vinn Atrius and GEMINI 16 prepare to awaken Zildrog.]]
Using the map's information, the Order learned that Zildrog was located on [[Nathema]] and moved its base of operations there, taking what they could from the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] and tasking Theron Shan with wiping all data and destroying the rest. However, Shan was in fact a double agent working the Alliance the whole time and left encrypted backups of the data, as well as a message meant for the Alliance. As he expected, the message was intercepted, and the Alliance Commander with Lana Beniko [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|headed to Nathema]]. Meanwhile, the Order excavated Zildrog in the ruins of an ancient [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]], assisted by their allies with personal vendettas against the Commander.<ref name="Nathema" />

[[File:GEMINI_16_and_Vinn_Atrius_uncover_betrayal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gemini 16 and Vinn Atrius realize that Theron Shan had betrayed them.]]
Theron slipped away from the Order and rejoined his friends, but GEMINI 16 noted their presence and Atrius ordered to begin the ritual meant to awaken Zildrog ahead of schedule. The GEMINI deceived and betrayed some of their allies, locking them inside energy transfer chambers to be used as fuel for Zildrog's awakening, when the Alliance battled the Order's forces and reached Zildrog's location. Shan shot Atrius, but GEMINI 16 trapped the Alliance members in a [[force field]] and revealed that the machine god was already awakened. Zildrog then used his connection to the [[Dark Sanctuary]] to remotely take over the ''[[Gravestone]]'' which was parked on the Alliance capital of [[Odessen]]. Zildrog took the ''Gravestone'' into Odessen's orbit and proceeded to repeatedly fire its [[omnicannon]] at the [[Eternal Fleet]], which sat defenseless in the abscence of orders from the Eternal Throne. <ref name="Nathema" />

[[File:Zildrog_hijacks_Gravestone.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Awaken, Zildrog takes over the ''Gravestone''.]]
After annihilating the Eternal Fleet, Zildrog targeted Odessen itself and began to recharge before the next attack, dropping the force field and forcing GEMINI 16 to engage the Alliance directly. Lana, Theron and the Commander battled and destroyed the GEMINI droid, and Theron attempted to shut Zildrog down, but was stabbed in the back with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]] by Vinn Atrius. Desperate to have his vengeance, Atrius ordered Zildrog to enhance him with its power, after which he attacked Lana and the Commander with his new increased strength. The two of them defeated Atrius and destroyed Zildrog, but the last act also triggered the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] of the ''Gravestone'' and disabled the Eternal Throne. The Alliance had lost two of its most powerful weapons but endured, while the Order of Zildrog was finished, leaving the Commander to decide Vinn Atrius' fate.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Order's membership changes depending on the player's class and choices made throughout the base game and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. Three people appear as [[Zildrog]]'s victims during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint, two of which are introduced in holorecordings on the [[abandoned listening post]], while the third confronts the player before the second boss fight of the flashpoint:<ref name="Nathema" />
*Either [[Chela Nayss]] or [[Zera]], depending on the player's choice to support or attack [[Senya Tirall]] during ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' '''Chapter I: Wrath and Ruin'''.<ref name="Nathema" />
*Either [[Darth Mortis]] or [[Indo Zal]], depending on the player's choice to claim the [[Eternal Throne]] as peacekeeper or the new [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] during ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' '''Chapter IX: The Eternal Throne'''.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], either [[Servant One]] or [[Bela Kiwiiks]] depending on the player's [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] alignment.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Jedi Consular]]s, either [[Sophia Farash]] or [[Gaden-Ko]] depending on the player's Light or Dark alignment.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]], either [[General/Legends|General]] [[Essith]] or [[Elin Garza]], depending on the player's choice to support either Republic or Sith Empire during the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]], either [[Nexia Kirill]] or [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sumalee]], depending on the player's choice to pledge the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet for the Republic or claim them for themselves towards the end of their class story.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunters]], either [[Malea Janarus]] or [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vindis]], depending on the player's choice to kill [[Dorian Janarus]] or [[Darth Tormen]] towards the end of their class story.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Imperial Agent]]s, either [[Shara Jenn]] if the player became a double agent for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], or [[Marcus Trant]] otherwise.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Sith Warrior]]s, either [[Darth Baras]] or [[Darth Ravage]], depending on the player's choice to spare or kill Baras towards the end of their class story.<ref name="Nathema" />
*For [[Sith Inquisitor]]s, either [[Darth Zash]] or [[Khem Val]], depending on the player's choice to put of them in the [[Mind prison]] towards the end of Khem's companion story arc.<ref name="Nathema" />
